notes: Scope-first planning and Test → Diag: new guided/proof drafts save scope separately, request acceptance evidence against stable feature indexes, then compile small tasks before full-proposal approval. Specific validation codes and multiple failure paths replace generic outline errors. Test runs bounded storage/controller/catalogue checks; optional local or explicitly consented cloud probes send only a fixed tiny JSON fixture. Results persist into Diag without executing generated code, changing routes or influencing cooldowns. Continuous local runtime snapshots and Diag capture loaded model context/VRAM metadata, Ollama version and actual requested API/JSON mode. Startup interruption cleanup removes only the process-owned instance marker even before serving begins. Existing projects, frozen checks, consent and rollback remain intact. Fixtures do not establish live model quality or restore quotas.
